title: stat263-project
summary: A STAT263 course project that reuses an external synthetic-data evaluation framework (borrowed from another GitHub repo) to statistically compare synthetic data generation methods, using SDV's SingleTableMetadata for schema definition and the sdmetrics NewRowSynthesis metric for evaluation.
needs: The evaluation_framework.py file is a vendored copy from novelcore/synthetic_data_evaluation_framework; no call site confirms SDV objects are actually instantiated/used within this repo's own notebooks.
